info.title: Lawgraph API
info.description: Lawgraph is a FastAPI layer over the ArangoDB knowledge graph. It exposes endpoints for articles of law, judgments, parliamentary dossiers and legislative history.

get.description: Looks up an article by `bwb_id` and `article_number`, adds its parent instrument and every judgment that cites it, plus the article references recorded on the article itself.

get.summary: Passages of judgments that cite an article
get.description: One row per passage: a judgment and the paragraph in it that cites the article, with the lid, onderdeel or aanhef it names, a snippet and the confidence of the detection. Newest judgment first. `court` (ECLI court code), `tier` and `lid` (a lid number the passage names) filter; `total` counts all passages that match. 404 when the article is unknown.

get.description: Every version of one article, identified by the stable BWB `stam_id` so renumbering does not break the chain, oldest first. Each version carries its validity period, text, the kind of change (`change`: introduces / amends / repeals), the amending publication (`amended_by`) and the commencement publication (`commencement`) with their dossiers. 404 when the article is unknown.

The dossiers that introduced, amended or repealed this article, or propose to: one entry per change and dossier, with the amending publication (enacted, `canoniek`) or the bill (proposed, `voorgesteld`) that carries it; proposed first, then newest first. What only cites the article (a judgment, another article) is not history. The explanatory documents are at `explained-by`. Returns an empty list when there is no history — never a 404.

The documents that explain this article: every EXPLAINS edge that points at the article (`target` `article`) or at one of its versions (`target` `article_version`); an explanation of the law as a whole is no evidence about this article and is not listed. Newest first. An explanation of `scope` `dossier` is written per dossier: the memorandum explains all the changes of the dossier; of `scope` `article` the memorandum names the section about this article in `section_anchor` (the `id` of a section of the document; `GET /api/documents/{key}/passages` gives its text). One document appears once per level. `total` counts all explanations, independent of `limit` and `offset`. Returns an empty list for an unknown article — never a 404.

A paginated list of judgments with filters on court (the ECLI court code), tier (the Type of the court in the Instanties value list of the Rechtspraak: hoge_raad, raad_van_state, gerechtshof, rechtbank, tuchtcollege, andere_instantie, koninkrijksinstantie, …), court_kind (the kind of court within the tier: ambtenarengerecht, raad_van_beroep, gerecht_in_eerste_aanleg, …), area of law (`subject`), source, date range and a minimum citation count. `facets` counts the judgments under the filters per `tier` (without the tier and court_kind filters), per `court_kind` (without its own filter), per `source` (without the source filter) and per year of `date` (without `from` and `to`).

get.summary: EU and international links of an instrument
get.description: `implements`: EU acts whose CELEX number the text of this instrument names. `implemented_by`: national regulations that name the CELEX number of this EU act. Both are `IMPLEMENTS` edges between instruments, written from a CELEX number named in the text (`basis`): not a transposition relation, not per article. `international`: treaties (BWB treaties) that articles of this instrument refer to, and ECHR judgments that refer to it or to its articles, each with the evidence of its edge; the graph holds no other links to treaties or to the articles of the ECHR Convention from Dutch text. The instrument is named by BWB id, CELEX number or node key; 404 when unknown. `limit` bounds each list; the `*_total` fields are absolute.

The articles in force of this instrument (BWB id or CELEX number), in the order of the document: an article with only a heading (the Algemene bepaling of the Grondwet) where it stands, an annex after the regulation. `include_repealed` adds the repealed identities (last). The text is a short preview; /api/articles/{bwb_id}/{address} has the full content.

get.summary: Explore a node and its neighbors
get.description: Fetches a node from the given collection and returns its neighbors from the unified edge collection in buckets, one per relation, direction and neighbor collection. Each neighbor carries the edge that leads to it: `edge_id`, `status`, `confidence` and `meta`. A bucket holds one page (`limit` neighbors from `offset`, in the same order on every request), its `total`, and the `next_offset` of the following page (null on the last). `relations`, `node_types`, `direction` and `status` narrow the edges; the totals count what remains.

* ``accompanies``: a budget change is submitted with the ``nota`` its title names

* ``related_to``: the Kamer relates a case of the one dossier to a case of the other
  (``Zaak.GerelateerdNaar``), mostly a letter of the government to the motion it
  answers. ``cases`` counts the pairs of cases, ``case_kinds`` names their kinds
  (``Brief regering → Motie``).
* ``second_reading_of``: a change in the Grondwet in its second reading and the dossier of
  its first reading, whose papers explain it: the memorandum of 35785 only refers to those
  of 35418 and 35419.

``outgoing`` means this dossier is the subject: 37035-XXII revises 36800-XXII and
accompanies 37020. On 36800-XXII the same ``revises`` is ``incoming``.

subkind.description: What the source calls it: the document kind (``Motie (gewijzigd/nader)``), for a vote what was voted on (the ``Zaak.Soort``: ``Motie``, ``Amendement``, ``Wetgeving``, ...); null for the other kinds.

dossier.description: Its first dossier; null for an event without one.

persons.title: Persons
persons.description: Who signed it, in the order of the source: the submitters of a paper, of the paper a vote decided, the bewindspersoon of a commitment.

ministry.description: Of a commitment its own; otherwise the ministry that brought its dossier in (``ministry`` of the dossier).

official_url.title: Official Url
official_url.description: The official text of a publication or a version of a law.

tk_url.title: Tk Url
tk_url.description: The page of a paper on tweedekamer.nl.

FeedNodeDTO.title: FeedNodeDTO
FeedNodeDTO.description: The node an event is: ``/api/nodes/{collection}/{key}`` shows it.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name they go by and the surname: ``Hanneke Steen``.

surname.title: Surname
surname.description: With its prefix, as written: ``van der Plas``.

function.title: Function
function.description: What they signed as, as the source writes it: ``minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid``, ``Tweede Kamerlid``.

faction.description: The faction a Kamerlid signed for; null for a bewindspersoon.

FeedPersonDTO.title: FeedPersonDTO
FeedPersonDTO.description:
Someone who signed the event: submitted a paper (``indiener``), signed it with the
one who did (``medeindiener``), or signed it or made the commitment for the
government (``bewindspersoon``).

instruments.title: Instruments
instruments.description: The laws it amends, introduces or repeals (or articles of), by title; at most ten.

FeedPublicationDTO.title: FeedPublicationDTO
FeedPublicationDTO.description: A ``publicatie`` in the Staatsblad, the Staatscourant or the Tractatenblad.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as ``cursor`` for the next page; null on the last page.

total.title: Total
total.description: Events under the filters, all pages; null without facets.

data_as_of.title: Data As Of
data_as_of.description: Per source: how current the graph is, as in `GET /api/stats`.

days.title: Days
days.description: Every day of the window, newest first.

items.title: Items
items.description: The events shown one by one, feed order.

data_as_of.title: Data As Of
data_as_of.description: Per source: how current the graph is, as in `GET /api/stats`.

FeedSummaryResponse.title: FeedSummaryResponse
FeedSummaryResponse.description: A few days of the feed in one answer.

tally.title: Tally
tally.description: Seats per choice as the source writes it (``Voor``, ``Tegen``, ``Niet deelgenomen``); members per choice on a roll-call.

function.title: Function
function.description: The post as Rijksoverheid names it: Minister voor Klimaat en Energie.

ministry.description: The ministry the post falls under (``GET /api/ministries``); a minister without portfolio under the ministry the post is placed under.

seat.title: Seat
seat.description: The seat the post is held in: ministry, post and the portfolio the source names (``ienw/minister``, ``jenv/staatssecretaris/rechtsbescherming``); ``#2`` for a second seat the source does not name.

to_date.title: To Date
to_date.description: The day it ended, as Rijksoverheid gives it: the day of the change, on which the next cabinet (holder, phase) takes office; so the period runs from ``from_date`` up to, not including, ``to_date``, and ``to_date`` is the ``from_date`` of what follows. Null while it lasts.

GovernmentFunctionDTO.title: GovernmentFunctionDTO
GovernmentFunctionDTO.description: A post held in a cabinet, as Rijksoverheid names it, and normalised.

InstrumentArticleBreadcrumbDTO.title: InstrumentArticleBreadcrumbDTO
InstrumentArticleBreadcrumbDTO.description:
One division an article stands in, outermost first: ``type`` is the element of the
BWB XML (``boek``, ``titeldeel``, ``hoofdstuk``, ``afdeling``, ``paragraaf``, ...),
``label`` as printed ("Hoofdstuk 1"), ``title`` its heading.

article_number.title: Article Number
article_number.description: Null for an article with only a heading, and for a repealed one.

label.title: Label
label.description: `Artikel 287`, or the heading of an article without a number (`Algemene bepaling`).

heading.title: Heading
heading.description: The title of its kop (`Definities`); most articles have none.

address.title: Address
address.description: The `{article_number}` segment of the article routes: the number (`287`, `8:54`), or for an article without one the rest of its key (`stam_16464063` of the Algemene bepaling of the Grondwet; a repealed identity `2_10_stam_2866303`). It stays the same across versions.

official_url.title: Official Url
official_url.description: The article in force on wetten.overheid.nl (its JCI).

repealed.title: Repealed
repealed.description: The article is no longer in force: an identity whose number another article has now, or one its current version repeals.

last_article_number.title: Last Article Number
last_article_number.description: The number a repealed identity last had.

InstrumentArticleNodeDTO.title: InstrumentArticleNodeDTO
InstrumentArticleNodeDTO.description:
Lightweight article shape for the graph-loader.

No full ``text`` field — that would balloon the payload when loading
hundreds of articles for a single instrument. ``text_preview`` carries
the first few characters so the FE has something to render on the node;
use /api/articles/{bwb_id}/{article_number} for full content.

label.title: Label
label.description: `Artikel 1:3`, or the heading of an article without a number.

heading.title: Heading
heading.description: The title of its kop (`Definities`); most articles have none.

breadcrumb.title: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.description: The divisions the article stood in on the day asked for, outermost first: those of the toestand of that day.

valid_until.title: Valid Until
valid_until.description: The first day the version is no longer in force, exclusive: the start of the next one. `2021-07-01` is in force up to and including 2021-06-30 (wetten.overheid.nl: "t/m 30-06-2021"). Null while it is in force.

text.title: Text
text.description: The whole text; null when it was not asked for.

text_preview.title: Text Preview
text_preview.description: The first ``text_preview_chars`` characters of the text.

InstrumentArticleVersionDTO.title: InstrumentArticleVersionDTO
InstrumentArticleVersionDTO.description: One historical version of a single BWB article, in its place on the day asked for.

total.title: Total
total.description: Every article in force on ``at_date``, independent of ``limit`` and ``offset``.

first_version_from.title: First Version From
first_version_from.description: The start of the first toestand of the law the source gives (the oldest ``valid_from`` of its versions). Before it the source gives no law: the route is empty, also where an article's own ``valid_from`` is older.

InstrumentArticlesAtResponse.title: InstrumentArticlesAtResponse
InstrumentArticlesAtResponse.description: Articles of an instrument as-of a specific date.

bwb_id.title: Bwb Id
bwb_id.description: The instrument as requested: its BWB id, or its CELEX number for an EU act.

total.title: Total
total.description: Absolute count of articles matching the request, independent of ``limit`` — use to render a '+N more' badge.

bwb_id.title: Bwb Id
bwb_id.description: BWB id of a Dutch regulation or treaty; `ECHR-CONVENTION` for the Convention of the ECHR.

celex.title: Celex
celex.description: CELEX number of an EU act.

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.description: Every name it is cited by: the official abbreviations and, for a book of a code, `Boek 6 BW`, `6 BW`, `BW 6`, `BW6`, `BW`.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: BWB type (`wet`, `AMvB`, `verdrag`, ...), treaty kind or publication kind.

source.title: Source
source.description: The source that created the node (`bwb`, `eurlex`, ...).

date_signed.title: Date Signed
date_signed.description: When the instrument itself was signed; for a BWB regulation that of the publication that enacted it, not of a later amendment.

date_published.title: Date Published
date_published.description: When the instrument itself was published.

date_in_force.title: Date In Force
date_in_force.description: When the instrument itself entered into force.

version_date_in_force.title: Version Date In Force
version_date_in_force.description: BWB: the start of the version in force (its toestand).

treaty_number.title: Treaty Number
treaty_number.description: A treaty: its Verdragenbank id (six digits), which the BWB text of the treaty names too (`wetgeving@verdragnummer`).

official_url.title: Official Url
official_url.description: The official text: wetten.overheid.nl for a BWB regulation, EUR-Lex for an EU act, the Verdragenbank for a treaty, zoek.officielebekendmakingen.nl for a publication from 1995; null for none.

same_treaty.title: Same Treaty
same_treaty.description: The other instruments with its treaty number: the Verdragenbank record of a BWB treaty, the BWB text of a Verdragenbank treaty.

InstrumentDetailDTO.title: InstrumentDetailDTO
InstrumentDetailDTO.description: One instrument: its identifiers, names, classification and dates.

current_phase.title: Current Phase
current_phase.description: The current phase of the dossier's bill (``phases``).

via.title: Via
via.description: How the dossier is linked: ``instrument`` = LEGISLATED_IN from the regulation itself, ``amending_publication`` = LEGISLATED_IN from a publication that amends, introduces or repeals one of its articles.

publication.title: Publication
publication.description: Identifier (e.g. ``stb-2019-33``) of the newest amending publication linking the dossier; only set when ``via`` is ``amending_publication``.

InstrumentDossierItem.title: InstrumentDossierItem
InstrumentDossierItem.description: One parliamentary dossier touching this instrument.

bwb_id.title: Bwb Id
bwb_id.description: The instrument as requested: its BWB id, or its CELEX number for an EU act.

total.title: Total
total.description: Absolute number of dossiers touching this instrument (independent of ``limit``).

implements.title: Implements
implements.description: EU acts whose CELEX number the text of this instrument names.

implemented_by.title: Implemented By
implemented_by.description: National regulations whose text names the CELEX number of this act.

international.title: International
international.description: Treaties that articles of this instrument refer to and ECHR judgments that refer to it, at most `limit`, treaties first.

cited_articles.title: Cited Articles
cited_articles.description: Articles of the focal instrument that this judgment cites.

InstrumentJudgmentItem.title: InstrumentJudgmentItem
InstrumentJudgmentItem.description: One judgment that cites this instrument.

bwb_id.title: Bwb Id
bwb_id.description: The instrument as requested: its BWB id, or its CELEX number for an EU act.

total.title: Total
total.description: Absolute number of judgments citing this instrument (independent of ``limit``).

official_url.title: Official Url
official_url.description: The official text: wetten.overheid.nl for a BWB regulation, EUR-Lex for an EU act, the Verdragenbank for a treaty, zoek.officielebekendmakingen.nl for a publication from 1995; null for none.

outbound_count.title: Outbound Count
outbound_count.description: Number of REFERS_TO edges from articles of the focal instrument to articles of this related instrument.

inbound_count.title: Inbound Count
inbound_count.description: Mirror of ``outbound_count`` in the opposite direction.

InstrumentRelatedItem.title: InstrumentRelatedItem
InstrumentRelatedItem.description: One other instrument linked via cross-article REFERS_TO edges.

bwb_id.title: Bwb Id
bwb_id.description: The instrument as requested: its BWB id, or its CELEX number for an EU act.

total.title: Total
total.description: Absolute number of related instruments (independent of ``limit``).

celex.title: Celex
celex.description: CELEX number of an EU act.

official_url.title: Official Url
official_url.description: The official text: wetten.overheid.nl for a BWB regulation, EUR-Lex for an EU act, the Verdragenbank for a treaty, zoek.officielebekendmakingen.nl for a publication from 1995; null for none.

inbound_citation_count.title: Inbound Citation Count
inbound_citation_count.description: What refers to the instrument and to its articles.

valid_until.title: Valid Until
valid_until.description: The first day the version is no longer in force, exclusive: the start of the next one. `2021-07-01` is in force up to and including 2021-06-30 (wetten.overheid.nl: "t/m 30-06-2021"). Null while it is in force.

InstrumentVersionDTO.title: InstrumentVersionDTO
InstrumentVersionDTO.description: One historical version (toestand) of a BWB instrument.

InstrumentVersionsResponse.title: InstrumentVersionsResponse
InstrumentVersionsResponse.description: Paginated list of historical versions for one instrument.

own_article.description: The article of this instrument at the edge, when it has one.

counterpart_article.description: The article of the treaty the reference names.

source.title: Source
source.description: The pipeline that wrote the edge.

InternationalLinkDTO.title: InternationalLinkDTO
InternationalLinkDTO.description:
A `REFERS_TO` edge between this instrument and an international counterpart.

`treaty`: an article of this instrument (`own_article`) refers to a treaty
(`instrument`), and to a treaty article (`counterpart_article`) when the reference names
one. `echr_judgment`: an ECHR judgment (`judgment`) refers to an article of this
instrument (`own_article`) or, without an article, to the instrument as a whole.

leden.title: Leden
leden.description: Numbers of the leden named (`['1', '2']`), ranges written out.

onderdelen.title: Onderdelen
onderdelen.description: Letters or numbers of the onderdelen named (`['a']`, `['2']`).

qualifier.title: Qualifier
qualifier.description: The qualifier as the judgment wrote it, `derde lid`, of the strongest mention. `leden`, `onderdelen` and `aanhef` (this class) are what it names.

paragraph_ids.title: Paragraph Ids
paragraph_ids.description: The paragraphs that cite the article, in reading order.

paragraph_numbers.title: Paragraph Numbers
paragraph_numbers.description: Their printed numbers (`5.3`), those that have one.

snippet.title: Snippet
snippet.description: The text around the strongest mention.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: The confidence of the strongest mention.

mention_count.title: Mention Count
mention_count.description: How often the judgment cites the article. The paragraphs cover the first 100; a judgment that cites an article more often is counted in full.

JudgmentCitedArticle.title: JudgmentCitedArticle
JudgmentCitedArticle.description: An article a judgment cites, with where and how: the strongest of its mentions.

stubs.title: Stubs
stubs.description: Cited judgments whose text is not loaded.

tiers.title: Tiers
tiers.description: Per tier: the highest courts first, the parket, the courts of first instance and appeal, the disciplinary tribunals, the other colleges, the Caribbean part, then the courts outside the Netherlands, the EHRM last.

JudgmentCoverageResponse.title: JudgmentCoverageResponse
JudgmentCoverageResponse.description:
Which judgments the graph holds: a count of case law is a count of this selection.

``total`` counts the judgments whose text is loaded; ``stubs`` the judgments known only
because a loaded text cites them (they cite nothing themselves).

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: The inhoudsindicatie, in Dutch. For an English translation the inhoudsindicatie of the judgment it translates; null while that is not loaded.

summary_en.title: Summary En
summary_en.description: An English inhoudsindicatie: that of the judgment itself when it is an English translation, else that of its translation. Null when there is none.

translation_of.title: Translation Of
translation_of.description: For an English translation, the ECLI of the Dutch judgment it translates (the authentic text); null otherwise.

names.title: Names
names.description: What lawyers call the judgment: `Haviltex`, `Urgenda`, `Lindenbaum/Cohen`. From a curated list of landmark cases; empty for most.

decision_kind.title: Decision Kind
decision_kind.description: What the decision is: `arrest`, `vonnis`, `beschikking`, `uitspraak`, `beslissing` (the kantonrechter on an appeal against a traffic fine), `conclusie` or `prejudiciële beslissing`. From the metadata and the kop where they tell, else from the court and the area of law; null when nothing does.

series_id.title: Series Id
series_id.description: The series of parallel cases the judgment is one of (the same court, day and, nearly, text): the lowest ECLI in it. Null outside a series.

series_size.title: Series Size
series_size.description: How many judgments the series has.

unresolved_appeal_targets.title: Unresolved Appeal Targets
unresolved_appeal_targets.description: The decisions an appeal says in its text it appeals ("tegen de uitspraak van de rechtbank Gelderland van 9 juli 2025 in zaak nr. 24/6811") that are not loaded; one that is loaded is its `APPEAL_OF` edge. Empty for most.

parties.title: Parties
parties.description: The parties the kop of the judgment names, in its order. Null when the judgment was normalized before parties were read; empty when the kop names none.

JudgmentDTO.title: JudgmentDTO
JudgmentDTO.description: Rich judgment DTO that hides raw XML but exposes metadata.

cited_articles.title: Cited Articles
cited_articles.description: The same articles, each with the passages of the judgment that cite it: paragraphs, the lid or onderdeel named, a snippet.

series.title: Series
series.description: The other judgments of its series (`judgment.series_id`), in the order of their ECLI numbers; empty outside a series.

JudgmentFacetCount.title: JudgmentFacetCount
JudgmentFacetCount.description: How many of the judgments have one value.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: Per tier, most first; counted without the `tier` and `court_kind` filters.

court_kind.title: Court Kind
court_kind.description: Per kind of court, most first; counted without the `court_kind` filter (within a chosen `tier`).

source.title: Source
source.description: Per source (`rechtspraak`, `echr`), most first; counted without the `source` filter.

year.title: Year
year.description: Per year of `date` (`2024`), oldest first after null (no date); counted without `from` and `to`.

JudgmentFacets.title: JudgmentFacets
JudgmentFacets.description: The judgments under the filters, counted; each without its own filter.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: The coarse tier: the Type of the court in the Instanties value list of the Rechtspraak (`hoge_raad`, `gerechtshof`, `rechtbank`, `tuchtcollege`, `andere_instantie`, `koninkrijksinstantie`, …), or `kroon`, `hvj_eu`, `ehrm`.

court_kind.title: Court Kind
court_kind.description: The kind of court within the tier, from its official name (`ambtenarengerecht`, `raad_van_beroep`, `gerecht_in_eerste_aanleg`, …); a tier of one kind of court is its own kind (`hoge_raad`).

names.title: Names
names.description: What lawyers call the judgment: `Haviltex`, `Urgenda`, `Lindenbaum/Cohen`. From a curated list of landmark cases; empty for most.

decision_kind.title: Decision Kind
decision_kind.description: What the decision is: `arrest`, `vonnis`, `beschikking`, `uitspraak`, `beslissing` (the kantonrechter on an appeal against a traffic fine), `conclusie` or `prejudiciële beslissing`. From the metadata and the kop where they tell, else from the court and the area of law; null when nothing does.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.description: The areas of law the source gives it (Rechtspraak `dcterms:subject`), as written: `Strafrecht`, `Bestuursrecht; Belastingrecht`. Empty when it gives none.

paragraph_id.title: Paragraph Id
paragraph_id.description: Names the paragraph in the judgment, for a deep link: `rov-5.3` for the numbered consideration 5.3, `kop-5` for a numbered heading, `p-12` (its position) for a paragraph without a number. Unique in the judgment.

number.title: Number
number.description: The number as printed, without its closing dot (`5.3`); not part of `text`. Null for a paragraph without one.

citations.title: Citations
citations.description: Every citation of an article in `text`, one per occurrence, with its span (`text[start:end]`).

JudgmentParagraph.title: JudgmentParagraph
JudgmentParagraph.description: A single paragraph from a judgment, with the article citations in it.

name.title: Name
name.description: As the judgment writes it, anonymised where the source is: `[eiser]`, `MAATSCHAP GRONINGEN`. Without its legal form, place or role.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Every role the judgment names for the party, in its order: `Geïntimeerde` and `Appellant` for one that is geïntimeerde in principaal and appellante in incidenteel hoger beroep. `[role]` when it names none.

role_stated.title: Role Stated
role_stated.description: True when the judgment names the role (a role line, a role behind the name, an anonymised name that is a role: `[verdachte]`); false when it is derived from the area of law and the side.

side.title: Side
side.description: The side of the case: `first` before `tegen` or `en`, `second` after it, `other` for an interested party (belanghebbende).

alias.title: Alias
alias.description: What the judgment calls the party: `EBN` for "hierna: EBN", `KLM` for "geïntimeerden worden hierna KLM respectievelijk VNV genoemd".

JudgmentParty.title: JudgmentParty
JudgmentParty.description: A party of a judgment, read from its kop.

JudgmentRepresentative.title: JudgmentRepresentative
JudgmentRepresentative.description: Who acts for a party, as the kop names them ("advocaat: mr. X").

JudgmentSummaryDTO.title: JudgmentSummaryDTO
JudgmentSummaryDTO.description: Lightweight judgment summary for listing matches.

dossier_id.title: Dossier Id
dossier_id.description: Arango _id of the dossier; null when the publication names a dossier that is not in the graph.

date.title: Date
date.description: Of the bill, or the publication date of the publication.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Document kind of a bill, publication kind (`Stb`) of a publication.

document_id.title: Document Id
document_id.description: Arango _id of the publication or the bill.

LegislativeHistoryEntry.title: LegislativeHistoryEntry
LegislativeHistoryEntry.description:
One change of an article in one dossier: the dossier, and the amending publication
(enacted) or the bill (proposed) that made or proposes the change.

LinkedInstrumentDTO.title: LinkedInstrumentDTO
LinkedInstrumentDTO.description: The instrument at the other end of a link.

full_name.description: ``Gerard Adriaan van der Steur``; null when the TK gives none.

government_functions.title: Government Functions
government_functions.description: The posts held in a cabinet (from Rijksoverheid), oldest first.

to_date.title: To Date
to_date.description: The last day, inclusive (the Kamer's TotEnMet); null while open.

MemberDTO.title: MemberDTO
MemberDTO.description:
A member of parliament or a minister.

``active`` means they hold an open faction membership — currently seated.
``party`` comes from that same membership, so the two always agree.

``from_date`` / ``to_date`` are only filled when the member is returned
as part of a committee, where they carry that committee seat's period.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name they go by: ``Ard van der Steur`` (``Persoon.Roepnaam``); for a minister who never sat in parliament, as Rijksoverheid gives it.

full_name.title: Full Name
full_name.description: ``Gerard Adriaan van der Steur``; null when the TK gives none.

government_functions.title: Government Functions
government_functions.description: The posts held in a cabinet (from Rijksoverheid), oldest first.

to_date.title: To Date
to_date.description: The last day, inclusive (the Kamer's TotEnMet); null while open.

government_name.title: Government Name
government_name.description: The name as Rijksoverheid writes it: S.Th.M. Hermans.

MemberDetailDTO.title: MemberDetailDTO
MemberDetailDTO.description:
A member with the posts they held in government.

``government_functions`` come from Rijksoverheid (every post in a cabinet since 1945),
oldest first; empty for a member who held none. A bewindspersoon is matched to a member
of parliament by surname, initials and age, a minister who never sat in parliament by

(key ``rijksoverheid_<initials>_<surname>``).

external_id.title: External Id
external_id.description: TK Besluit identifier of the decision.

choice.title: Choice
choice.description: The vote as the source wrote it: Voor, Tegen, Onthouden, …

seats.title: Seats
seats.description: Seats behind this vote; 1 on a roll-call.

MemberVoteDTO.title: MemberVoteDTO
MemberVoteDTO.description:
One vote a member took part in.

``party`` is the party they sat for on ``date``, which may differ from
the party they sit for now.

count.title: Count
count.description: Votes returned; may be fewer than the total.

MinistryDTO.title: MinistryDTO
MinistryDTO.description:
A ministry name of ``data/ministries.json``: a name that came back (Economische
Zaken) has a period for each time; a former one names its successor and the last day
it had its name (``successor`` and ``until`` of its last period).

from_date.title: From Date
from_date.description: Null where no source dates it.

until.title: Until
until.description: The last day; null while it has the name, or where unknown.

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: The Staatscourant decree the end rests on (from TOOI).

source.title: Source
source.description: ``tooi`` (the TOOI value list, since about 2010) or ``rijksoverheid`` (the first post and a handover on the cabinet pages).

successor_source.title: Successor Source
successor_source.description: ``curated`` for a succession no source gives (before 2010; ``data/curated/ministries.json``).

MinistryPeriodDTO.title: MinistryPeriodDTO
MinistryPeriodDTO.description: A stretch in which the ministry had its name, and where that is known from.

NeighborBucketDTO.title: NeighborBucketDTO
NeighborBucketDTO.description: The neighbours that share a relation, a direction and a collection: one page of them.

NeighborDTO.title: NeighborDTO
NeighborDTO.description: A neighbour with the edge that leads to it, used by the generic node explorer.

NodeNeighborhoodResponse.title: NodeNeighborhoodResponse
NodeNeighborhoodResponse.description: One-shot N-hop neighborhood: focal + reachable nodes + spanning edges.

seating_plan.description: The plan of the Tweede Kamer the order of `factions` follows.

ParliamentSeatsResponse.title: ParliamentSeatsResponse
ParliamentSeatsResponse.description: The current seat composition of the Tweede Kamer.

aliases.title: Aliases
aliases.description: Another name of a party (`GL-PvdA`, `CU`) -> its name in `colors`.

PartyColorsResponse.title: PartyColorsResponse
PartyColorsResponse.description: Party to hex colour, by every name and alias; and the aliases.

faction.title: Faction

PartyRefDTO.title: PartyRefDTO
PartyRefDTO.description: A party as the source writes it (``VVD``, ``partijloos``), and its faction.

section_id.title: Section Id

match_type.title: Match Type

PassageDTO.title: PassageDTO
PassageDTO.description: The passage of a memorandum that explains an article.

name.title: Name
